item.description:
Always-there brand marks

  • The menu's Claude Desktop and Codex rows now show LittleSwitch's own bundled brand marks instead of borrowing the installed applications' icons, so every row reads correctly from the very first launch — no matter which apps are installed.

Fixes

  • Provider save failures are now reported inside the editor sheet instead of a generic app alert.

Live model remaps — Claude Code & Claude Desktop

  • Remapping a route now applies immediately to running Claude apps: no relaunch, and open conversations follow along.
  • The served model catalog is invariant: route IDs and display names never move, so clients keep their model picker selections across remaps.
  • New Model indicator setting: choose how mapped routes are marked in the served model lists (⇌ equilibrium, ⇄ swap, ⇢ routed, ↦ maps-to, or plain).

Tabbed status menu

  • The menu is now organized into Overview, Claude, and Codex tabs.
  • The Claude tab maps the Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku routes in place with steppers and a single Apply action; the Codex tab sets the default Codex model.
  • Each tab shows its client's 30-day token history chart.
  • Steppers preview the chosen model immediately and reconcile when the apply lands.

Fixes

  • Codex refusals now explain which agents form was refused instead of surfacing a raw error code.
  • Compact token counts hold steady at display-rounding boundaries.
  • Menu tab content spacing is balanced top and bottom.
